passage.quote:
The forward computation turns a nonempty row of finite binary32 scores into
encoded softmax outputs. The row length is a power of two, at most 1024, and
scores have magnitude at most 2^124. Maximum and sum use parallel reductions.
Exponential and normalization passes also run in parallel: each thread reads
one input and a common scalar, then overwrites only its own input cell. A
sequential reference composition remains available. Both compositions permit
the same final arrays; this relates their results without equating their schedules.
Neither composition claims fused execution or measured GPU performance.

summary: Execute independent shifted-exponential and normalization lanes with actual shared-program fetch, candidate reads and in-place output stores.
Derive original operands from ownership, program order and existing memory admission, preserving all admitted numerical outcomes.
Prove stored-output correctness, access safety and an independently admitted execution witness without hardware or fairness claims.

from.quote:
An elementwise pass assigns one output cell to each lane, where a lane is one
participating thread. All lanes fetch the same straight-line instruction program.
Each lane loads its own input and a common scalar, computes a shifted exponential
or a rounded normalization, stores the result back to its own cell, and exits.
The common scalar lies outside the output prefix. Distinct lanes never write
each other's cells. The first domain is one nonempty group of at most 1024 lanes,
using the same finite-score and numerical conditions as the reference softmax.

from.quote:
The machine accepts arbitrary lane interleavings and candidate load values.
Arithmetic steps reuse the existing addition, multiplication, exponential and
reciprocal instruction relations, retaining all permitted numerical outcomes.
Entry initialization sets each lane’s program counter to zero and supplies its
own-cell and common-scalar address registers. This is an explicit input interface,
not a fetched address-calculation program or a runtime launch proof. Other initial
register values are arbitrary. Every step checks actual instruction fetch and the target. An enabled exponential
outside the existing supported domain has no arithmetic step; a completed-run
proof must not assume that this missing step exists. This adapter has no barriers
or shared-memory operations. Parallel reductions retain their separate machine.

passage.quote:
inductive Exec (candidate : Option Word) (thread : Fin n) : Instr → State n → State n → Event n → Prop
  | scalarNext {i s next event} (eval : Scalar.eval candidate i (input s thread)=.next next event) :
      Exec candidate thread (.scalar i) s (install s thread next (s.lanes thread).halted) (.scalar thread event)
  | scalarHalted {i s next event} (eval : Scalar.eval candidate i (input s thread)=.halted next event) :
      Exec candidate thread (.scalar i) s (install s thread next true) (.scalar thread event)
  | binary {i s next event} (eval : Scalar.Binary32.Eval i (s.lanes thread).scalar next event) :
      Exec candidate thread (.binary i) s (setLane s thread ⟨next,(s.lanes thread).halted⟩) (.binary thread event)
  | exponential {i s next event} (eval : Scalar.Exponential.Eval i (s.lanes thread).scalar next event) :
      Exec candidate thread (.exponential i) s (setLane s thread ⟨next,(s.lanes thread).halted⟩) (.exponential thread event)
  | reciprocal {i s next event} (eval : Scalar.Reciprocal.Eval i (s.lanes thread).scalar next event) :
      Exec candidate thread (.reciprocal i) s (setLane s thread ⟨next,(s.lanes thread).halted⟩) (.reciprocal thread event)

from.quote:
Memory admission applies the existing whole-word constraints to the actual
emitted loads and stores, with no additional cross-thread order. A read cannot
silently receive the value intended by the proof. For a lane's own input cell,
any noninitial writer would be that lane's later output store. The instruction
order places the read before that store, and the memory model forbids using a
causally later store as the source of the read. No lane writes the common scalar.
These facts derive each operand's original value for every admitted execution.
They do not restrict all executions to a globally sequential memory order.

from.quote:
Softmax uses one such pass after its parallel maximum and another after its
parallel sum. Phase boundaries retain the existing explicit waiting and scratch
initialization model; they are not a CUDA runtime implementation or fused kernel.
The new passes and the sequential reference permit exactly the same final arrays.
Both directions are proved through a contract giving each stored result’s
instruction relation and preserving all cells outside the output prefix. This
keeps the numerical allowances and initial-score accuracy guard unchanged,
without selecting a unique approximate exponential result. Masking,
arbitrary row lengths and benchmarking remain separate. The backward component
uses the existing two-input pointwise machine for its difference and product
passes; it does not require this exponential/reciprocal adapter.

passage.quote:
The composed execution contains actual fetched instructions and exact memory
writeback at each phase. Parallel phases retain their admitted read observations
and separate completed-execution witnesses. For elementwise passes, ownership
and instruction order prove that each admitted load sees the original operand:
other threads cannot write its input, and its own output store occurs later.
The sequential reference passes instead read the current arena directly.
Resetting entry registers, allocating shared scratch and waiting for a phase to
complete are explicit operations of the composition model. They do not implement
CUDA allocation, launch, waiting or device visibility. No arithmetic value is
supplied by those operations in place of a load or store.
